name: bp-paper-editor
description: TipTap-vanilla per-block premium editor for Barkpark papers. Bundles to a single committed Web Component artifact, mirroring the bp-* vendoring pattern.

scripts.build:web: npm run build && cp ../../priv/static/assets/bp-paper-editor.bundle.js ../../../web/public/bp-paper-editor.bundle.js && mkdir -p ../../../web/public/assets && cp ../../priv/static/assets/bp-paper-editor.css ../../../web/public/assets/bp-paper-editor.css
scripts.test: node src/__smoke.mjs && node src/__callout_shorthand.test.mjs && node src/__wikilink.test.mjs
